title: 通用人工智能中的自适应纠缠博弈模块
summary: 论文提出基于概率波的行为智能框架，用非局域概率波方程建模自适应智能体集体行为。通过分析中国股市日内数据，发现自适应纠缠博弈模式可解释82-94%的决策行为，远优于新古典金融学的独立理性智能体预测，支持LCA非局域纠缠神经纤维假说。作者主张将自适应纠缠博弈模块纳入AGI架构，结合ANN与脑启发模拟，开发类人处理单元（HPU），以实现更紧凑高效的AGI系统。
summary_en: This paper introduces a probability-wave framework using a generalized behavioral intelligence nonlocal probability-wave equation to model collective behavior of interacting adaptive agents. Analysis of Chinese intraday stock data shows adaptive entangled game modes explain 82-94% (89% overall) of decision patterns, sharply contrasting with neoclassical finance's independent rational agent predictions, and empirically supporting the Liu-Chen-Ao hypothesis of nonlocal entangled nerve fibers. The authors argue for incorporating adaptive entangled game modules into AGI architectures, integrating ANN-based AI with probability-wave entangled-brain simulations to develop human-like processing units (HPUs) for more compact, efficient, robust AGI, especially in embodied intelligence and robotics.
